neighbours.label: aspectual adverb of completion timing across languages: 'yet', 'already', 'just/recently' (未, уже, ya, recién, yet)
fire: The paint on the fence has not yet dried, so please don't touch it.
By the time we arrived, the guests had already eaten dessert.
La tienda ya cerró cuando llegamos a la plaza.
Мы уже купили билеты на поезд.
Tenemos un cachorro recién nacido en casa.
这个问题至今仍未解决。
The results of the vote are not known yet, officials said.
My sister has already moved to Berlin for her new job.
quiet: The paint on the fence is still very bright, so please admire it.
By the time we arrived, the guests were happily eating dessert.
La tienda cerró temprano cuando llegamos a la plaza.
Мы купили билеты на поезд вчера.
Tenemos un cachorro muy pequeño en casa.
The results of the vote are shown on the screen, officials said.
My sister has happily moved to Berlin for her new job.

notes: Card: '未' x10, 'ién' x4, ' yet' x4, ' уже' x3, ' ya' x3; probe: recién 0.95, уже 0.52, not yet 0.41, 'often' control 0.20.
